d: A single woman's recent loss has her longing for a new furry friend  Winnie could be the perfect match, but Winnie will need to work hard to fit in with the adopter's active lifestyle.
A 1-year-old Maltese mix could be the perfect match for a young woman whose cross-country journey left her longing for a canine companion.

When a former “Lucky Dog” family shows interest in adopting a second dog, Brandon thinks he has the perfect fit. But only time and training will tell if the Cotter family's Tibetan Terrier, Pluto, ends up with a new furry friend.

A fishing enthusiast becomes downcast after a rare condition nearly leaves him paralyzed. But, happiness could be on the horizon as he hopes to hook the perfect catch: a canine companion and fishing buddy, named King.

After rescuing a senior dog that was abandoned by his previous family, Brandon introduces the troubled terrier to a new recreational activity that could keep the dog healthy, while helping him bond with two young victims of bullying.
Even during some major construction at the Lucky Dog Ranch, Charlotte, Spirit, and three other dogs undergo life-changing renovations of their own.
Brandon rescues a one-year-old Border Collie that was saved from a puppy mill. But before this dog can be successfully re-homed, her natural herding instincts will be put to the test.

After rescuing a pair of bonded shelter dogs, Eric and Rashi must find a home in which two dogs would be welcome. A potential match could be made with a couple in San Diego who are still mourning the loss of their two previous dogs.

A sweet Terrier mix is matched up with a couple who are mourning the loss of their two previous dogs. Active Annie jumps at the chance to earn a place in their hearts, while simultaneously offering entertainment for their grandchildren.
Before a young, energetic Golden Retriever can be a companion for a family, Brandon will have to teach him control and how to safely navigate around wheelchairs.

Brandon must earn the trust of a Wheaten Terrier Mix who shows difficulty adjusting to life outside of a cage. But only time will tell if this anxious animal can be fully prepared for life in the busy tourist town of Solvang, California.
To prepare a young Foxhound for a woman hoping for a companion, Brandon will have to help the dog overcome her separation anxiety and keep her nose out of trouble.
Eric and Rashi place three different shelter dogs into the homes of adopters whose lives revolve around music, photography and an assortment of arts and crafts.
Eric checks in with past adopters whose isolation during the initial COVID-19 lockdown inspired the decision to welcome a new furry friend into their lives.
Brandon rescues a malnourished Poodle mix, suffering from an upper respiratory infection, in hopes that she might be the perfect companion for a woman coming to grips with her own failing eyesight.
